sloka: पादयोः शरण अन्वेषी चतुर्भिः सह राक्षसैः ।अब्रवीच् च तदा रामम् वाक्यम् तत्र विभीषणः ॥६-१९-३॥।।
transliteration: pādayoḥ śaraṇa anveṣī caturbhiḥ saha rākṣasaiḥ ।abravīc ca tadā rāmam vākyam tatra vibhīṣaṇaḥ ॥6-19-3॥।।

translations.english: Although he (Vibheeshana) has defects, as he has come here with a friendly feeling, I cannot reject him. Good people are not reprehensible.
